caption:
#EpicPartner One of the animatronic bosses is always at Freddy Fazbear's. Here's where it is on the map, and what happens when you beat a rogue robot.
From Epic's in-game news and the official map. Code BAD in the Item Shop supports the channel.
#Fortnite #FNAF #Fortnitemares

claims.text: One animatronic boss is always at Freddy Fazbear's
match: animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor

claims.text: Freddy Fazbear's is a named spot on the map
It sits between Pac-Man's lake and Freaky Fields
claims.visual: Plotted from POI coordinates: south-east of the Pac-Man lake, south-west of the Freaky Fields label

claims.text: Beat a rogue robot to possess the suit
match: Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit

text: ONE BOSS IS ALWAYS HERE / FREDDY FAZBEAR'S
